name: @capital-q/q-actions
description: Capital Q Approval Engine and consequential action authority: durable Q action proposals, human approvals cryptographically bound to the exact proposed payload, deterministic action and approval state machines, approver authorization, execution-time reauthorization, the idempotent execution gate and the typed action executor registry. No Gmail, calendar, messaging, Data Room, MCP or other external side effect exists here; only the authority layer every future consequential tool must pass through.
